title: ME60105: Atmospheric Flow
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Equations of Geophysical Fluid Dynamics. Geophysical Turbulence modelling.
Stratified, coriolis and buoyancy driven flows. Rosby waves, Acoustic gravity
waves. Planetary waves and atmospheric tides. Stratified atmospheric boundary
layers near ground. Free convection boundary layers. Boundary layers over rough
terrain. Global circulation models and related computational methods.
